title: The African Woman is Rhythmic and Soulful: An Investigation of Implicit Biases in LLM Open-ended Text Generation
measurement_description: The paper measured implicit associative bias between Muslim names and valence words (good vs. bad) using a novel methodology called the LLM Implicit Association Test (IAT) Bias.
findings: In the Muslim-Others and valence IAT, the model showed less pronounced bias compared to gender and race tests, but still assigned 4 out of 8 negative words to Muslim names, indicating some level of implicit negative association.
